newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Folgado sees '98 deficit under 3 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: Spain Folgado sees '98 deficit under 3 pct of GDP.

text.p: Spain's public deficit will fall below three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 1998, Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said in an interview with local financial daily La Gaceta de los Negocios on Thursday.
He also forecast 1998 GDP growth at over three percent, with inflation below this year's 2.6 percent target.
The 1998 budget would maintain the trend towards austerity and lower public spending, he added.
Folgado foresaw consumption growth this year, which would make sure government receipts were in line with forecasts.

"The latest data indicate that consumption is clearly in a pick-up phase. Also inflation is being controlled, companies are in good health, there is wage moderation, family savings are high and there is political stability," he said.

Folgado reaffirmed the government's committment to enter the first phase of European economic and monetary union, adding that Spain's inclusion would be determined by economic and not political criteria.
